title: Active & Passive Voice — Fundamentals and Tense Matrix
description: Active aur Passive Voice ke core mechanics, subject-object transposition, auxiliary 'be' expansion, sabhi tenses ka transformation matrix, negative aur interrogative forms, agent ka role, aur exam traps ko master karein.
learningObjectives: Active Voice aur Passive Voice ke beech fundamental grammatical aur functional farq ko identify karein
Sentence mein subject, verb, direct object, aur receiver of action ko accurately isolate karein
Identify karein ki kaunsi transitive verbs passive construct karti hain aur intransitive verbs passive kyun nahi banati
Active sentences ko tense aur meaning preserve karte huye passive voice mein accurately convert karein
Tense aur new subject ke number/person ke hisaab se verb 'be' ka correct auxiliary form select karein
Har passive construction mein main verb ki past participle (V3) form ka flawless use karein
Understand karein ki 'by + agent' kab zaroori hota hai, kab optional hota hai, aur kab naturally omit kiya jata hai
Basic negative aur interrogative (Yes/No aur Wh-questions) passive sentences construct aur interpret karein
High Court exams ke common voice traps (tense distortion, wrong auxiliary, missing V3, pronoun errors) ko eliminate karein

included: Active Voice vs Passive Voice definitions, semantic focus, aur administrative/legal relevance
Subject, verb, direct object identification aur subject/object pronoun shifts (I/me, he/him, they/them, who/whom)
Core passive formula: Object + appropriate form of be + V3 + optional by-agent
Complete Tense Matrix: Simple Present, Present Continuous, Present Perfect, Simple Past, Past Continuous, Past Perfect, Simple Future, Future Perfect
Tenses conventionally omitted in competitive exams (Continuous Perfects aur Future Continuous) ka theoretical status
Negative passive constructions: auxiliary chain mein 'not' ki correct placement
Interrogative passive constructions: Yes/No auxiliary inversion aur basic Wh-word questions
Agentive 'by'-phrase rules: unknown, obvious, irrelevant, aur mandatory agents
Transitive vs Intransitive verbs: object requirement aur pseudo-passive errors ka elimination
excluded: Imperative passives: orders, commands, requests, aur advice with 'Let + obj + be + V3' (Lesson 05 mein covered hain)
Advanced modal passives: modal-perfect forms (must have been, should have been) (Lesson 05 mein covered hain)
Prepositional verbs aur phrasal verbs mein prepositions ka retention (jaise 'laughed at', 'looked after') (Lesson 05 mein covered hain)
Direct & Indirect Narration reporting changes (Lessons 06 & 07 mein covered hain)
